name: decision
what: Your words, verbatim, with the time: an answer, a gate approval or a correction, numbered D-1, D-2 and on. The human in the loop, recorded; whether it still holds is computed by brain's reflection.

fields.name: about
fields.means: its topics, to group the decisions that hold

fields.name: supersedes
fields.means: earlier decisions it replaces, in whole or in part, with what; written by the reflection

fields.name: session, intents
fields.means: where it came from, what it affects

fields.name: reflection
fields.means: what it was checked against and the result; who, when and how are on the event that wrote it

written_by: The step that asked you, as an event of the intent it affects, which also runs brain's reflection.
